entities.summary: Kenneth Wayne Lofton Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Shanghai Sharks of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He played college basketball for the Louisiana Tech Bulldogs, and played for the Memphis Grizzlies, Philadelphia 76ers, and Utah Jazz of the NBA league. He is a two-time all-conference selection in Conference USA, including first-team honors as a sophomore in 2022.
